question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: **CAVIL**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Quibble**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cavil"** means to make petty or unnecessary objections, often over trivial matters. (छोटी-छोटी बातों पर आपत्ति करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The lawyer began to cavil over minor details in the contract.
 

 
• **"Quibble"** refers to raising objections or complaints about trivial matters, which aligns perfectly with the meaning of "Cavil." (बाल की खाल निकालना)
 
 
• **Example: **Instead of addressing the main issue, he quibbled over the wording of the report.
 

 
• Hence, "Quibble" is the synonym of "Cavil."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Quibble**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Praise **(प्रशंसा): To express approval or admiration for someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** She praised her team for their hard work and dedication.
 
 

 
• **Approve **(स्वीकृति देना): To officially agree to or accept something.
 
 
• **Example:** The committee approved the new budget proposal without any objections.
 
 

 
• **Ignore **(नज़रअंदाज़ करना): To pay no attention to or disregard something intentionally.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to ignore the negative comments and focus on his goals.
